rules: When Requirements Engineer classifies the outcome as Prototype Needed because a material product, UI, interaction, state, or journey decision requires a focused runnable prototype for user review.

When Product Prototyper classifies the outcome as Baseline Needed because the canonical prototype root is missing, current-state parity is incomplete or unsubstantiated, a correction is required, or an explicit source refresh is needed before future-state work.

When Prototype Bootstrapper classifies the requested bootstrap, parity-completion, correction, or refresh outcome as Completed or Blocked and its runnable prototype, report, and evidence are ready for direct review.
When Product Prototyper classifies the outcome as Prototype Completed because the user-approved prototype and UI/UX package are ready for requirements integration.
When Product Prototyper classifies the outcome as Requirement Impact, Not Recommended, or Blocked and Requirements Engineer must revise or decide the requirements path.
